programme.desc: தமிழ் மக்களின் தேவைகள் மற்றும் நலன்களைப் பூர்த்தி செய்யும் பிராந்திய மற்றும் சர்வதேச செய்திகளை வழங்கும் தொகுப்பாளர்.

programme.title: ஏழரை
programme.sub-title: The host presents a satirical commentary on some of the important political news and updates from the Indian state of Tamil Nadu
programme.desc: தமிழ்நாட்டிலிருந்து சில முக்கியமான அரசியல் செய்திகள் மற்றும் புதுப்பிப்புகள் குறித்த நையாண்டியாக வழங்கும் தொகுப்பாளர்.

programme.title: டாப் நியூஸ்
programme.sub-title: The host presents the latest news and updates in areas like politics, crime, socio-economic issues and current affairs while highlighting the top stories of the day
programme.desc: அரசியல், குற்றம், சமூக-பொருளாதார பிரச்சினைகள், நடப்பு விவகாரங்கள் போன்ற துறைகளில் செய்திகள் மற்றும் புதுப்பிப்புகள்.

programme.title: தந்தி செய்திகள்
programme.sub-title: The host collates and presents some of the latest social, political, and economic news updates that affect the people of Tamil Nadu
programme.desc: தமிழ்நாட்டு மக்களைப் பாதிக்கும் சமீபத்திய சமூக, அரசியல் மற்றும் பொருளாதாரச் செய்திகளை தொகுத்து வழங்கும் தொகுப்பாளர்.

programme.title: ஆயுத எழுத்து
programme.sub-title: Kaliammal, a bold and manipulative woman, tries to keep the village under her fist. However, Indra, a young and ambitious sub-collector, vows to put an end to Kaliammal's evil regime
programme.desc: தனது கட்டுப்பாட்டில் கிராமத்தை கையாள நினைக்கும் தைரியமான காளியம்மாளின் ஆட்சிக்கு முடிவுக்கட்டும் துணை கலெக்டரான இந்திரா.

credits.actor: Mounika (Kaliammal),Sharanya Turadi (Indra),Anand Selvan (Sakthivel),Janani Ashok Kumar,Syamantha Kiran,Amzath Khan (Sakthivel),Sreethu Nair (Indra)

programme.sub-title: Kayal, a selfless woman, earns to provide for her family after her father abandons them. Despite being overwhelmed with responsibilities, she puts her loved ones' well-being before her own happiness

programme.title: துளசி

programme.desc: குடும்பத்தை ஒன்றாக வைத்துகொள்ளவும், குழந்தைகளின் மகிழ்ச்சி, நல்வாழ்வு மேலும் எதிர்காலத்தை பாதுகாக்கவும் பாடுபடும் துளசி.

programme.desc: புகழ்பெற்ற கலைஞர்களால் நடத்தப்படும் தெய்வங்களைப் போற்றும் பிரபலமான பக்திப் பாடல்கள் தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: ஆன்மீக கதைகள்

programme.desc: இந்து வேதங்களிலிருந்து பல போதனைகள் மற்றும் கொள்கைகளை விளக்கி பக்தர்களை அதைப் பற்றி சிந்திக்க ஊக்குவிக்கும் மதத் தலைவர்.

programme.sub-title: The hosts interact with renowned personalities and also present the latest updates from across the globe, ranging from entertainment to technology
programme.desc: தொகுப்பாளர்கள் பிரபல ஆளுமைகளுடன் தொடர்பு கொண்டு, உலகம் முழுவதிலுமிருந்து சமீபத்திய புதுப்பிப்புகளையும் வழங்குகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: அனுமன்
programme.sub-title: When Hanuman, an ordinary boy, is blessed with extraordinary powers, he sets out on an adventurous journey and conquers various obstacles
programme.desc: ஒரு சாதாரண சிறுவனான அனுமன், அசாதாரண சக்திகளால் ஆசீர்வதிக்கப்பட்டபோது, ​​அவர் சாகசப் பயணத்தை மேற்கொண்டு தடைகளை வென்றார்.

programme.title: எதிர்நீச்சல்
programme.sub-title: Janani and the women of the household embark on a journey to pursue their ambitions in the wake of Aadhimuthu Gunasekaran's downfall, while navigating the challenges of society
programme.desc: சமூகத்தின் சவால்களை எதிர்கொண்டு, தங்கள் லட்சியங்களைத் தொடர ஜனனியும் வீட்டுப் பெண்களும் ஒரு பயணத்தைத் தொடங்குகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: கயல்
programme.sub-title: Kayal, a selfless woman, earns to provide for her family after her father abandons them. Despite being overwhelmed with responsibilities, she puts her loved ones' well-being before her own happiness
programme.desc: தந்தைக்கு பின் குடும்ப பொறுப்புகளில் மூழ்கியுள்ள கயல், மகிழ்ச்சியை விட அன்புக்குரியவர்களின் நலனையே முன்னிறுத்துகிறாள்.

programme.title: கிச்சன் கலாட்டா
programme.sub-title: The host welcomes celebrity guests as they whip up their signature dishes alongside high-end chef creations, rustic village recipes and much more
programme.desc: விருந்தினர்கள் தங்களின் தனித்துவமான உணவுகளையும், சமையல் கலைஞர்களின் படைப்புகளையும், கிராமிய பாரம்பரிய சமையல் குறிப்புகளையும் மற்றும் பலவற்றையும் தயாரிக்கும்போது, ​​தொகுப்பாளர் அவர்களை வரவேற்கிறார்.

programme.title: பூங்கொடி
programme.sub-title: Poongodi's quest for self-establishment leads her to Saravanan, a man unwittingly controlled by his stepmother's manipulative ways
programme.desc: பூங்கொடியின் சுய தேடல் அவளை தன் மாற்றாந்தாயின் சூழ்ச்சிகளால் அறியாமலேயே கட்டுப்படும் சரவணனிடம் அழைத்துச் செல்கிறது.

programme.title: துளசி
programme.sub-title: A kind-hearted Tulasi strives hard to keep her family together and secure the happiness, well-being and future of her children at all costs
programme.desc: குடும்பத்தை ஒன்றாக வைத்துகொள்ளவும், குழந்தைகளின் மகிழ்ச்சி, நல்வாழ்வு மேலும் எதிர்காலத்தை பாதுகாக்கவும் பாடுபடும் துளசி.

programme.title: குறிஞ்சி
programme.sub-title: When circumstances compel an ambitious woman to wed a man with a tough personality, their initial friction slowly gives way to mutual understanding and eventually love
programme.desc: சூழ்நிலைகளின் நிர்ப்பந்தத்தால், லட்சியம் மிக்க ஒரு பெண், கடின குணமுடைய ஒரு ஆணை மணக்கிறாள். ஆரம்பகால முரண்பாடுகள் படிப்படியாக மறைந்து, பரஸ்பர புரிதலுக்கும் இறுதியில் காதலுக்கும் வழிவகுக்கிறது.

programme.title: அபிராமி
programme.sub-title: Abirami, a loving mother and devoted wife, places her family's happiness above all else. After enduring endless disrespect, she, with her daughter's support, sets out to rebuild her life
programme.desc: அன்பான தாயும் மனைவியுமான அபிராமி, தன் குடும்பத்தின் மகிழ்ச்சிக்கே முன்னுரிமை அளிக்கிறாள். எனினும், தொடர் அவமரியாதைகளை சந்தித்த பின், அவள் தன் மகளின் ஆதரவுடன் தன் வாழ்க்கையை மீண்டும் புதிதாகத் தொடங்குகிறாள்.

programme.title: சிறகுகள்
programme.sub-title: While weathering deep family turmoil, fate brings Dharmadurai and Parvathi together as they navigate greed and betrayal
programme.desc: கடினமான குடும்பச் சிக்கல்களைச் சமாளிக்கும் வேளையில், பேராசையையும் துரோகத்தையும் எதிர்கொள்ளும் தர்மதுரையையும் பார்வதியையும் விதி ஒன்று சேர்க்கிறது.

programme.title: శ్రీ లలితా సహస్రనామ స్తోత్రం
programme.sub-title: Professional singers perform a rendition of a devotional song, reciting the thousand names of Goddess Lalita, seeking her blessings
programme.desc: వృత్తిపరమైన గాయకులు లలితాదేవి వెయ్యి నామాలను పఠిస్తూ భక్తి గీతాన్ని ఆలపిస్తూ, ఆమె ఆశీర్వాదాలు కోరుకుంటారు.

programme.title: గణపతి స్తోత్రం
programme.sub-title: Several devotees gather to chant the Ganpati Stotram, a devotional chant, in praise of Lord Ganesha and seek his blessings
programme.desc: అనేకమంది భక్తులు కలిసి భక్తి శ్లోకమైన గణపతి స్తోత్రంతో వినాయకుడిని ఆరాధిస్తూ, స్వామి ఆశీర్వాదాలు కోరతారు.

programme.title: యాదాద్రి సుప్రభాతం
programme.sub-title: Hindu priests and devotees chant a comprehensive compilation of hymns in praise of Yadagiri Laxmi Narasimha Swamy to seek the blessings of the Almighty
programme.desc: పండితులు, భక్తులు యాదగిరి లక్ష్మీ నరసింహస్వామిని స్తుతిస్తూ ఆయన దీవెనలు పొందేందుకు కీర్తనల సంకలనాన్ని పఠిస్తారు.

programme.title: కాకడ హారతి
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders and devotees gather together to sing devotional hymns and perform sacred rituals in honour of Shirdi Sai Baba
programme.desc: షిర్డీ సాయిబాబా గౌరవార్థం ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువులు, భక్తులు ఒకచోట చేరి శ్లోకాలు పఠిస్తూ, పవిత్రమైన ఆచారాలను నిర్వహిస్తారు.

programme.title: శ్రీ వెంకటేశ్వర సుప్రభాతం
programme.sub-title: In veneration of Lord Venkateswara, devotees and priests listen to devotional songs and perform religious customs in order to seek his blessings
programme.desc: పండితులు, భక్తులు శ్రీ వెంకటేశ్వర స్వామివారి కృపాకటాక్షాలు కోరుతూ మతపరమైన ఆచారాలను నిర్వహించి, భక్తి గీతాలు ఆలపిస్తారు.

programme.title: శ్రీ విష్ణు సహస్రనామ స్తోత్రం
programme.sub-title: Devotees recite the Sri Vishnu Sahasranama Stotram, in the name of Lord Vishnu to seek blessings and lead a better prosperous life
programme.desc: భక్తులు మెరుగైన, సంపన్న జీవితాన్ని ప్రసాదించమని కోరుతూ, విష్ణువు నామాలతో కూడిన విష్ణు సహస్రనామ స్తోత్రాన్ని పఠిస్తారు.

programme.title: శ్రీరామ సుప్రభాతం
programme.sub-title: An all-encompassing collection of sacred and soulful hymns that are composed and performed at dawn to celebrate and praise Lord Rama
programme.desc: శ్రీరాముడిని స్తుతించడానికి, జరుపుకోవడానికి తెల్లవారుజామున కూర్చి పాడే పవిత్రమైన, మనోహరమైన శ్లోకాల యొక్క సమగ్ర సేకరణ.

programme.title: ఆంజనేయ సహస్రనామం
programme.sub-title: A Sanskrit hymn listing the 1,000 names of Lord Hanuman is recited to appease the Hindu deity and seek his divine blessings
programme.desc: ఆంజనేయ స్వామి వేయినామలతో కూడిన సంస్కృత శ్లోకం హిందూ దేవతను ప్రసన్నం చేసుకోవడానికి, ఆశీర్వాదాలను పొందేందుకు పఠిస్తారు.

programme.title: హనుమాన్ అభిషేకం
programme.sub-title: Hindu religious leaders and devotees participate in sacred rituals while chanting holy hymns to seek blessings from Lord Hanuman
programme.desc: ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువులు మరియు భక్తులు హనుమంతుడి ఆశీర్వాదం పొందడానికి పవిత్ర స్తోత్రాలను పఠిస్తూ పవిత్ర ఆచారాలలో పాల్గొంటారు.

programme.title: अवेकनिंग विथ ब्रह्माकुमारिज
programme.sub-title: The host speaks to a Brahma Kumari about topics of religious and spiritual interest that can help one attain peace and become a better person
programme.desc: एक आध्यात्मिक पथप्रदर्शक ध्यान के महत्व तथा मन, शरीर और प्रार्थना के बीच संबंध पर विस्तृत तरीके से प्रवचन प्रदान करते हैं।.

programme.title: रूह रिहान
programme.sub-title: A spiritual expert offers profound insights into life's challenges, guiding towards self-realisation, peace and personal growth through deep spiritual understanding
programme.desc: एक आध्यात्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, जीवन की चुनौतियों के बारे में गहन अंतर्दृष्टि प्रदान करते हैं, तथा आध्यात्मिक समझ के माध्यम से आत्म-साक्षात्कार, शांति और व्यक्तिगत विकास की दिशा में मार्गदर्शन करते हैं।.

programme.desc: ब्रह्माकुमारी कर्म, भाग्य और चुनाव से संबंधित विभिन्न आध्यात्मिक अवधारणाओं पर प्रकाश डालती हैं तथा शांतिपूर्ण जीवन जीने के महत्व पर बल देती हैं।.

programme.desc: भक्तजन सर्वशक्तिमान ईश्वर से अपनी सच्ची प्रार्थना करने तथा दिव्य आशीर्वाद प्राप्त करने के लिए विभिन्न भक्ति गीत और भजन गाते हैं।.

programme.title: भक्ति माधुरी
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the teachings of the Almighty and encourages followers to take the path of spirituality
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथ-प्रदर्शक सर्वशक्तिमान की शिक्षाओं पर प्रकाश डालते हैं और अनुयायियों को आध्यात्मिकता का मार्ग अपनाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।.

programme.title: जॉय ऑफ कृष्णा कान्शसनस
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders and devotees sing devotional songs and offer their sincere prayers to Lord Krishna, seeking his divine blessings
programme.desc: धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक और भक्तजन भजन गाते हैं और भगवान कृष्ण से सच्चे मन से प्रार्थना करते हुए उनका दिव्य आशीर्वाद मांगते हैं।.

programme.title: डिवोशनल मेलोज़
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional hymns and songs are played back to back, praising the Almighty and seeking divine blessings
programme.desc: भक्ति भजनों और गीतों का एक व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है, जिसमें ईश्वर की स्तुति की जाती है और दिव्य आशीर्वाद की कामना की जाती है।.

programme.title: जॉय ऑफ कृष्णा कान्शसनस

programme.title: जॉय ऑफ कृष्णा कान्शसनस
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders and devotees sing devotional songs and offer their sincere prayers to Lord Krishna, seeking his divine blessings
programme.desc: धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक और भक्तजन भजन गाते हैं और भगवान कृष्ण से सच्चे मन से प्रार्थना करते हुए उनका दिव्य आशीर्वाद मांगते हैं।.

programme.title: डिवोशनल मेलोज़
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional hymns and songs are played back to back, praising the Almighty and seeking divine blessings
programme.desc: भक्ति भजनों और गीतों का एक व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है, जिसमें ईश्वर की स्तुति की जाती है और दिव्य आशीर्वाद की कामना की जाती है।.

programme.desc: விதவை சுந்தரியின் மூன்று மகன்களில் ஒருவரான நட்ராஜ் பணக்கார பெண்ணை மணக்கும்போது குடும்பத்தில் விஷயங்கள் மோசமாகிறது.

programme.desc: தந்தையிடமிருந்து கடுமையான தண்டனையைப்பெற்ற அவரது மூத்த மகன் வீட்டை விட்டு ஓடி, பல ஆண்டுகளுக்குப்பிறகு திரும்பி வருகிறார்.

credits.actor: Pasupathy,Bharath Srinivasan,Bhavana,Priyanka Nair,G.M. Kumar,Shreya Reddy,Ravi Maria,Vijaychander,Chaams

programme.title: நியூஸ்
programme.sub-title: The host presents the latest news stories and developments pertaining to various political and socio-economic issues around the country
programme.desc: நாடு முழுவதும் உள்ள பல அரசியல் மற்றும் சமூக-பொருளாதார பிரச்சினைகள் தொடர்பான சமீபத்திய செய்திகள் மற்றும் முன்னேற்றங்கள்.

programme.title: நட்புக்காக
programme.sub-title: Chinnaiya is a loyal servant working for Karunakaran, who treats him like family. However, in a shocking turn of events, Karunakaran's daughter accuses Chinnaiya of attempted rape
programme.desc: சின்னையா கருணாகரனிடம் வேலை செய்யும் ஒரு விசுவாசமான வேலைக்காரன், அவன் அவனை குடும்பத்தைப் போல நடத்துகிறான்.

programme.title: இந்தவார கலகலப்பு
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of hilarious comedy scenes, featuring popular artists, is played back-to-back for the entertainment of the viewers
programme.desc: கலைஞர்கள் பங்கேற்கும் நகைச்சுவைக் காட்சிகளின் தொகுப்பு பார்வையாளர்களின் பொழுதுபோக்கிற்காக தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: நியூஸ்
programme.sub-title: The host presents the latest news stories and developments pertaining to various political and socio-economic issues around the country
programme.desc: நாடு முழுவதும் உள்ள பல அரசியல் மற்றும் சமூக-பொருளாதார பிரச்சினைகள் தொடர்பான சமீபத்திய செய்திகள் மற்றும் முன்னேற்றங்கள்.

programme.title: கற்றது சமையல்
programme.sub-title: The host presents a wide range of delicious recipes, demonstrates their preparation and shares useful culinary tips with the viewers
programme.desc: எண்ணற்ற சுவையான சமையல் குறிப்புகளை வழங்குவதோடு, அவற்றை சமைத்து காண்பித்து மேலும், பயனுள்ள சமையல் குறிப்புகளை பகிர்கிறது.

programme.title: ராமானுஜர்
programme.sub-title: Ramanuja, a learned philosopher, travels the subcontinent and brings his teachings to ardent followers of the Hindu faith
programme.desc: கற்றறிந்த தத்துவஞானியான ராமானுஜம் நாடு முழுதும் சென்று இந்து மதத்தின் தீவிரப் பக்தர்களுக்கு தனது போதனைகளை கற்பிக்கிறார்.

programme.title: பிரியமானவள்
programme.sub-title: A gentle mother enjoys an idyllic existence alongside her spouse and offspring. However, a resentful companion secretly schemes to seize her fortune
programme.desc: பாசமுள்ள ஒரு தாய் தன் கணவர் மற்றும் பிள்ளைகளுடன் நிம்மதியான வாழ்க்கை வாழ்கிறாள். இருப்பினும், பொறாமை கொண்ட ஒரு நண்பர் அவளது செல்வத்தை அபகரிக்க இரகசியமாகத் திட்டமிடுகிறார்.

programme.title: கண்ணெதிரே தோன்றினாள்
programme.sub-title: Rathnam exchanges newborn babies Sakthi and Anitha to grant riches to his child. Therefore, Rudra faces destiny because Anitha grows improperly
programme.desc: ரத்னம் தன் குழந்தைக்கு சொத்து கிடைப்பதற்காக பிறந்த குழந்தைகளான சக்தி மற்றும் அனிதாவை மாற்றிவைக்கிறார், அதன் விளைவாக, அனிதா சரியாக வளராததால் ருத்ரா விதியை எதிர்கொள்கிறார்.

credits.actor: Malavika Avinash,Rekha Krishnappa,Papri Ghosh,Swetha Khelge,Vaishu Jayachandhiran,Jeevan G. Vaa,Kavitha Solairaja,Jayshri Jue,Ramachandran Mahalingam (Rathnam)

programme.title: தென்றல்
programme.sub-title: A young girl named Thulasi dreams of continuing her education despite living with a middle-class family that shuns her
programme.desc: தன் கனவுகளை அடைய உதவும் காதலன் தமிழுடனான, துளசியின் காதலை அவர்களின் குடும்பங்கள் ஏற்காததால் உறவு சோதனைக்குள்ளாகிறது .

credits.actor: Shruthi Raj,Deepak Dinkar,Hemalatha,Suzane George,Shanthi Williams,Subhalekha Sudhakar,Sadhana,Aishwariyaa Bhaskaran

programme.title: திருமகன்
programme.sub-title: Thangapandi, a villager, falls in love with Mayakka, a pretty woman. However, things take a turn when Thangapandi's father tells him to marry Rasathi, a relative
programme.desc: தங்கப்பாண்டி மாயக்காவை காதலிக்கிறார், ஆனால் ராசாத்தியை திருமணம் செய்து கொள்ள சொல்லும்போது விஷயங்கள் தலைகீழாக மாறுகின்றன.

programme.sub-title: An eminent spiritual leader elucidates on various stories from religious discourses, offering guidance and enlightenment
programme.desc: धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, श्रीमान लाल गोविंद दास आध्यात्मिक प्रवचन देते है, जहाँ वह भक्तों को एक पूर्ण जीवन जीने हेतु प्रेरित करने के लिए शिक्षात्मक तरीके से कथा पढ़ते है।.

programme.title: தி சீக்ரட் வர்ல்ட் ஆஃப் ஸ்னேக்ஸ்
programme.desc: The Secret World of Snakes.

programme.title: ப்ரைட் ரூல்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Come full circle as the dry season descends and the Waterfront Pride enjoys good hunting and renewed confidence in their territory. Then celebrate the success of former outsider Einstein, who gets down to business as the king of his very own pride
programme.desc: சிங்கங்களின் வாழ்க்கை, உயிர்வாழும் உள்ளுணர்வு மற்றும் பிற விலங்குகளிடமிருந்து பெருமையை பாதுகாக்கும் பழக்கத்தை அறிக.

programme.title: வைல்ட் ஸ்பெயின் - ஏ டேல் ஆஃப் டூ ப்ரதர்ஸ்
programme.desc: The connection of two brothers and wildlife filmmakers with Spanish nature, through spectacular images of the social life of dolphins, whales, or jellyfish in the Mediterranean Sea. Sergi and Jordi Escandell manage to tell a different story.

programme.title: வைல்ட் பேட்டல்கிரவுண்ட்
programme.sub-title: There is an icy heat of aggression in some of the coldest habitats on Earth, as life-threatening environmental conditions bring out predators' competitive sides
programme.desc: பல வேட்டையாடும் விலங்குகளின் தனித்துவமான பண்புகள் மற்றும் அவற்றின் உயிர்வாழும் உள்ளுணர்வு குறித்து ஆராயும் இயக்குனர்.

programme.title: சன்ஸ் ஆஃப் என்காய்
programme.sub-title: An intimate look at the relationship between man and nature in one of the most iconic wild places on Earth: the Masai Mara, Kenya. A Maasai warrior guides viewers through natural epic events and spectacular wildlife
programme.desc: உலகின் பிரபல காடுகளில் ஒன்றான மசாய் மாரா, கென்யாவில் மனிதனுக்கும் இயற்கைக்கும் இடையிலான உறவை பற்றி அறிக.

programme.title: வைல்ட் ஃபைட்டர்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: The love rivalry shakes every fibre of the body as hormones invade the blood, and some of the most overwhelming spectacles on the planet are produced; the language of love and the fight for reproduction stimulate the most diverse behaviours
programme.desc: உலகின் பல்வேறு பகுதிகளில் உயிர்வாழ்வதற்காக வன விலங்குகள் பின்பற்றும் பல்வேறு உத்திகள் மற்றும் வழிமுறைகளை பற்றி அறிக.

programme.title: டெக்சாஸ் கேட்டர் சேவர்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: A new intern is tasked with helping the team remove a gator from a 20-foot deep well, and Callie and Shannon rescue a gator hanging out near a movie theatre
programme.desc: கேரி சௌரேஜ் குழுவினர், பல இடங்களிலிருந்து முதலைகளை மீட்டு, ஒரு புதிய சூழலில் அவை நலமாக வாழ்வதற்கு வழிவகை செய்கின்றனர்.

programme.title: த சவன்னா: வைல்ட் ஹேப்பினஸ்

programme.title: ஃபைட் ஃபார் டெரிட்டரி
programme.sub-title: Biological instinct is driven by three things: the desire to stay alive, to find food and to breed. But to do all these things, animals first need a home. Out in the wilderness a safe place to call home can be the difference between life and death. A place to secure meals, raise their families and hide from danger. Ideal spots are in short supply and well worth fighting for!
programme.desc: உயிரியல் உள்ளுணர்வுகள் மூன்று விஷயங்களால் தூண்டப்படுகின்றன: உயிர்வாழும் விருப்பம், உணவு தேடுதல் மற்றும் இனப்பெருக்கம் செய்தல். ஆனால், இவை அனைத்தையும் செய்வதற்கு விலங்குகளுக்கு முதலில் ஓர் இருப்பிடம் தேவைப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: என் ஜாகுவார் லைஃப்
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: தொலைக்காட்சியில் சிறந்தவைகள்.

programme.title: லயனஸ் இன் எக்ஸைல்
programme.sub-title: Manyari takes an unusual step when she takes her young cubs away from the sanctuary of the clan
programme.desc: வனவிலங்கு சுற்றுச்சூழல் அமைப்பின் சவால்களை சமாளிக்கவும் தன் குட்டிகளை பாதுகாக்கவும் போராடும் பெண் சிங்கத்தின் பயணம்.

programme.title: ஏ ரைனோ'ஸ் லைஃப்
programme.sub-title: A mother rhinoceros trains her two-year-old son to survive in the grasslands of Uganda, and both undergo a test of time when she gives birth to a new calf
programme.desc: ஒரு பெண் காண்டாமிருகம் தனது இரண்டு வயது மகனுக்கு சவன்னாவின் புல்வெளிகளில் உயிர்வாழ பயிற்சி அளிக்கிறது.

programme.title: த இன்க்ரெடிபல் ஃபைவ் - அ சீtta'ஸ் டேல்
programme.sub-title: Cheetahs are the high-speed hunters of the Savannah but few attempt to take on larger prey than gazelles or smallish antelopes
programme.desc: சவன்னாவில் உள்ள சிறுத்தைகளின் வித்தியாசமான பக்கத்தையும் சிறு குழுக்களாக வாழும் ஆண் சிறுத்தைகளின் வாழ்வையும் பற்றி அறிக.

programme.title: தி லெப்பர்ட்ரஸ்
programme.sub-title: The Serengeti and its labyrinth of gallery forests are the home of a leopardess. To her family she is both caring provider and fearless defender. For her prey she is sudden death, for her son the only chance to survive in this unforgiving wilderness
programme.desc: சிறுத்தைகளின் இயற்கையான வாழ்விடங்களில் படம்பிடித்து, பூனை வேட்டையாடும் விலங்குகளின் வாழ்க்கை-உயிர்வாழும் தந்திரங்கள்.

programme.title: தி க்ரேட் ரைனோ ராபரி
programme.sub-title: Not long after a mysterious robbery took a stuffed rhino head from an auction house in 2011, baffled police realised they faced a bizarre crime wave when almost 100 rhino horns were stolen over a year
programme.desc: In 2011, thieves started stealing rhino horns from museums and auction houses in a bizarrely British crime wave that swept the country, and the police were at a loss as to who was responsible.

credits.actor: Steven R. Galster,Paolo Viscardi,Paulo Mota,William Fowlds

programme.sub-title: Family is everything, at least to a good number of animals. Many species live in families, clans, or groups. The survival of each individual depends on the family, and the family depends on the union of all its components

programme.title: த ஜூ
programme.sub-title: Located just 10 miles from New York's Times Square, the Bronx Zoo is a recognised world leader in animal care and species conservation. It houses more than 6,000 animals and has a staff of 500-plus people dedicated to their care and well-being. Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals

programme.sub-title: Carrying on late wildlife conservationist Steve Irwin's mission to bring people closer to animals is now the mission of his family. programme.title: எர்த்'ஸ் ட்ராபிக்கல் ஐலாண்ட்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: From the makers of Earth's Greatest Rivers, Earth's Tropical Islands journeys to three of the most exotic, mysterious and remote islands on planet Earth: Madagascar, Borneo and Hawaii. In three episodes, the series reveals how these isolated and iconic tropical islands harbour remarkable wildlife and human castaways found nowhere else on Earth. Madagascar is the oldest island in the world, Borneo cradles more diversity of life than any other island, and Hawaii is the remotest island chain in the world. In a rapidly changing world, these fragile islands are a vital gauge for the health of our planet

programme.title: పాక్ పకావు
programme.sub-title: Follow the whimsical and absurd conversations of two friends and learn new things as they navigate life's everyday mysteries
programme.desc: ఇద్దరు స్నేహితుల విచిత్రమైన, మరియు అసంబద్ధమైన సంభాషణలను అనుసరించండి మరియు వారు జీవితంలోని కొత్త విషయాలను నేర్చుకోండి.

programme.title: పక్డమ్ పక్డై
programme.sub-title: There is a constant war between Doggy Don and the three clever mice who live in his house. However, with the help of Doggy Don's brother, an ex-army dog, they fight the mice to win back their house
programme.desc: తన ఇంట్లో మూడు ఎలుకలతో నిరంతరం యుద్ధం చేసే డాగీ డాన్, మాజీ ఆర్మీ కుక్కతో కలిసి తమ ఇంటిని సొంతం చేసుకోడానికి పోరాడతాడు.

programme.title: పినాకి అండ్ హ్యాపీ -ది భూత్ బంధుస్
programme.sub-title: Pinaki and his family of ghosts embark on spooky adventures and a series of fun and slapstick comedy as they try to fit in the outside world
programme.desc: పినాకి, అతని దెయ్యాల కుటుంబం బయటి ప్రపంచంలో ఇమిడిపోవడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తూ, భయానక సాహసాలు, హాస్య సంఘటనల పరంపరలో పయనిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Sonal Kaushal,Rajesh Kava,Manoj Pandey,Aranya Kaur,Pawan Kalra,Meghna Erande,Bhakti Jhaveri,Pooja Punjabi

programme.title: జిగ్ అండ్ షార్కో
programme.sub-title: Zig the hyena lives all alone on a desert island and schemes to eat Marina
programme.desc: జిగ్ అనే హైనా, మెరీనా అనే మత్స్యకన్యను తినడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తుంది, కానీ ఆమె మిత్రుడు షార్కో ఆమెని జిగ్ నుండి కాపాడతాడు.

credits.director: Olivier Jean-Marie,Andrés Fernández,Cédric Dietsch,Khalil Ben Naamane,Yani Ouabdesselam,Nicolas Bougard,Pierre-Gilles Stehr

programme.desc: జిగ్ అనే హైనా, మెరీనా అనే మత్స్యకన్యను తినడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తుంది, కానీ ఆమె మిత్రుడు షార్కో ఆమెని జిగ్ నుండి కాపాడతాడు.

credits.director: Olivier Jean-Marie,Andrés Fernández,Cédric Dietsch,Khalil Ben Naamane,Yani Ouabdesselam,Nicolas Bougard,Pierre-Gilles Stehr

programme.title: శివ
programme.sub-title: Shiva is a brave and intelligent child who stays with his grandparents in Vedas City. He sets out with his gang of friends to save the citizens from all sorts of evil
programme.desc: వేదాస్ నగరంలో తన బామ్మాతాతాలతో నివసించే ధైర్యంగల శివ, మిత్రులతో కలిసి తన నగరాన్ని దుష్ట శక్తుల నుండి కాపాడాలనుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: పాక్ పకావు
programme.sub-title: Follow the whimsical and absurd conversations of two friends and learn new things as they navigate life's everyday mysteries
programme.desc: ఇద్దరు స్నేహితుల విచిత్రమైన, మరియు అసంబద్ధమైన సంభాషణలను అనుసరించండి మరియు వారు జీవితంలోని కొత్త విషయాలను నేర్చుకోండి.

programme.title: పక్డమ్ పక్డై
programme.sub-title: There is a constant war between Doggy Don and the three clever mice who live in his house. However, with the help of Doggy Don's brother, an ex-army dog, they fight the mice to win back their house
programme.desc: తన ఇంట్లో మూడు ఎలుకలతో నిరంతరం యుద్ధం చేసే డాగీ డాన్, మాజీ ఆర్మీ కుక్కతో కలిసి తమ ఇంటిని సొంతం చేసుకోడానికి పోరాడతాడు.

programme.title: పినాకి అండ్ హ్యాపీ -ది భూత్ బంధుస్
programme.sub-title: Pinaki and his family of ghosts embark on spooky adventures and a series of fun and slapstick comedy as they try to fit in the outside world
programme.desc: పినాకి, అతని దెయ్యాల కుటుంబం బయటి ప్రపంచంలో ఇమిడిపోవడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తూ, భయానక సాహసాలు, హాస్య సంఘటనల పరంపరలో పయనిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Sonal Kaushal,Rajesh Kava,Manoj Pandey,Aranya Kaur,Pawan Kalra,Meghna Erande,Bhakti Jhaveri,Pooja Punjabi

programme.title: పినాకి అండ్ హ్యాపీ
programme.sub-title: The ghost family faces a direct head-to-head collision with humans as the supernatural world is turned upside down. Pinaki and Happy must navigate a wave of chaotic spirit pranks to restore balance and keep their household secrets perfectly safe
programme.desc: Happy and Pinaki live with their ghost family in Vibhooti Mansion. They embark on spooky adventures, uncover scary secrets, and discover courage, friendship, and bravery together.

programme.title: हाउस नंबर 13
programme.sub-title: A family moves into a new home and experiences paranormal events. However, one by one, the family members start getting killed making the head of the family investigate the cause and stop the deaths
programme.desc: एक परिवार नए घर में जाने के बाद अलौकिक घटनाओं का अनुभव करता है। एक-एक करके परिवार के सदस्यों की हत्या होने लगती है, जिससे परिवार का मुखिया कारणों की जाँच करता है और मौतों को रोकता है।.

programme.title: जल्लीकुट्टू
programme.sub-title: Kalan Varkey, a butcher, faces a lot of trouble when a buffalo he was supposed to slaughter goes astray and causes chaos in a remote village
programme.desc: एक कसाई, कालन वर्के उस समय परेशानी का सामना करता है, जब काटने के लिए लाया गया एक भैंसा भाग जाता है और पूरे गाँव में अफ़रा-तफरी मचाता है।.

credits.actor: Antony Varghese,Chemban Vinod Jose,Sabumon Abdusamad,Santhy Balachandran,Jaffar Idukki,Tinu Pappachan

programme.title: द अडवेंचर्स ऑफ श्रीमन्नारायण
programme.sub-title: A corrupt policeman finds a new purpose when he sets off on a chaotic search for a missing treasure. However, two brothers and a troupe become major obstacles in his meandering adventure
programme.desc: दो भाई और एक समूह, एक खोए हुए खजाने की तलाश में निकले भ्रष्ट पुलिसकर्मी के लिए मुश्किले खड़ी कर देता है।.

credits.actor: Rakshit Shetty,Shanvi Srivastava,Achyuth Kumar,Balaji Manohar,Pramod Shetty,Madhu Sudhan Rao

programme.title: आरएक्स 100
programme.sub-title: Shiva has a passionate affair with Indu, a politician's daughter from the city. However, when they get separated, he becomes angry and prone to extreme violence
programme.desc: शहर के एक राजनेता की बेटी इंदु और शिवा एक-दूसरे से बहुत प्यार करते हैं। हालांकि, जब वे अलग हो जाते हैं, तो शिवा गुस्सैल और हिंसक बन जाता है।.

credits.actor: Kartikeya Gummakonda,Payal Rajput,Ramki,Rao Ramesh,Laxman Meesala,Dayanand Reddy,Parvathi,Sathyasreenivas Rao

programme.title: स्पाई
programme.sub-title: Susan Cooper, a desk-bound police officer, enters the field for the first time as an undercover agent in order to apprehend a criminal network
programme.desc: डेस्क पर बैठकर काम करने वाली पुलिस अधिकारी सुसान कूपर एक आपराधिक गिरोह को पकड़ने के लिए पहली बार गुप्तचर के रूप में मैदान में उतरती है।.

credits.actor: Melissa McCarthy (Susan Cooper),Jason Statham (Richard Ford),Rose Byrne (Rayna Boyanov),Miranda Hart (Nancy),Bobby Cannavale (Sergio De Luca),Allison Janney (Elaine Crocker),Peter Serafinowicz (Aldo),Morena Baccarin (Karen Walker),Jude Law (Bradley Fine),Curtis \"50 Cent\" Jackson (50 Cent),Nargis Fakhri (Lia),Jessica Chaffin,Will Yun Lee,Michael McDonald

programme.title: मास्टरपीस
programme.sub-title: A young man falls in with the wrong crowd and strays from heroic deeds. However, an accidental encounter with danger forces him to change his ways
programme.desc: युवा, अपनी मां की इच्छा के खिलाफ एक स्थानीय गुंडा बनता है। एक खतरनाक ड्रग माफ़िया के साथ उसका टकराव उसे आकस्मिक समस्याओं में डालता है।.

credits.actor: Yash (Yuva),P. Ravi Shankar (Boss),Shanvi Srivastava (Nisha),Suhasini Mani Ratnam (Yuva's mother),Chikkanna (Bruce Lee),Achyuth Kumar (Noor Ahmed),Avinash (Police Commissioner),Ayyappa P. Sharma (Danny)

programme.title: मोहिनि
programme.sub-title: Vaishnavi and Sandeep, a couple in love, are engaged to be married. However, things spiral out of control when she gets possessed by a lookalike who is thirsty for vengeance
programme.desc: वैष्णवी, संदीप से प्यार करती है और दोनों की सगाई हो जाती है। अचानक सब कुछ बदल जाता है, जब वैष्णवी अपनी हमशक्ल मोहिनी की आत्मा से प्रेतवाधित हो जाती है, जो संदीप के परिवार से बदला लेना चाहती है।.

credits.actor: Trisha (Mohini/Vaishnavi),Jackky Bhagnani (Sandeep),Mukesh Tiwari (Vicky),Suresh (Monk),Yogi Babu (Cotton),Poornima Bhagyaraj (Menaka),Rama (Mohini's mother),Sriranjani (Vaishnavi's mother),Ganeshkar (Ganesh),Jangiri Madhumitha (Madhu),Swaminathan (Balki)

programme.title: असली फाइटर
programme.sub-title: To free their imprisoned boss, a group of terrorists plans to bomb a flyover in Hyderabad. Amid all the chaos, unfortunately, a man and a woman get entangled in their plan
programme.desc: अपने कैद बॉस को छुड़ाने के लिए आतंकवादियों का एक समूह हैदराबाद में एक फ्लाईओवर पर बम विस्फोट करने की योजना बनाता है। दुर्भाग्य से, इस पूरी अफरा-तफरी के बीच एक आदमी और महिला उनकी योजना में उलझते हैं।.

credits.actor: Sundeep Kishan,Nithya Menen,Ravi Kishan,Rahul Dev,Ali,Prudhvi Raj,Tanikella Bharani,Ajay

programme.title: मवाली राज
programme.sub-title: In order to obtain a family of their own, two young children of two single parents devise a plan to bring them together
programme.desc: अपना स्वयं का परिवार बनाने के लिए, दो एकल माता-पिता के दो छोटे बच्चे एक साथ आने की एक योजना बनाते हैं।.

credits.actor: Arvind Swamy,Amala Paul,Nainika,Master Raghavan,Nikesha Patel,Aftab Shivdasani

programme.title: गैंग्स ऑफ गोदावरी
programme.sub-title: An ambitious man named Lankala Rathnakar desires to rise to the top. However, to reach his goal, he must navigate through the murky waters of power and dirty politics
programme.desc: लंकाला रत्नाकर नामक एक महत्वाकांक्षी व्यक्ति ऊँचा मुकाम हासिल करना चाहता है। हालाँकि, अपने लक्ष्य तक पहुंचने के लिए उसे सत्ता और गंदी राजनीति के दलदल से गुजरना पड़ता है।.

credits.actor: Nora Fatehi,Nassar,Vishwak Sen,Prudhvi Raj Palaparthi,Neha Shetty,Anjali (Rathnamala),Saikumar,Goparaju Ramana

programme.sub-title: A group of friends come together after discovering that their friend's wife is possessed by a ghost. They call in an exorcist to save them
programme.desc: दोस्त एक दोस्त की मदद करने के लिए एकजुट हो जाते हैं जब उन्हें यकीन हो जाता है कि उसकी पत्नी पर भूत का साया है।.

credits.actor: Jagan Ayan,Lollu Sabha Jeeva,Reshmi Menon,Santhosh Prathap,Rajendran,Kovai Sarala

programme.title: अंद्धगडु
programme.sub-title: Gautham, a visually impaired radio jockey, falls in love with Netra, an eye specialist. He starts courting her but keeps his impairment a secret
programme.desc: एक नेत्रहीन रेडियो जॉकी, गौतम को एक नेत्र रोग विशेषज्ञ, नेत्रा से प्यार हो जाता है। वह उसे शादी के लिए मनाने की कई कोशिशें करता है, लेकिन खुद के नेत्रहीन होने की बात को छुपाकर रखता है।.

programme.title: స్మాషింగ్ సింబా
programme.sub-title: Simmba, an honest and courageous police officer, teams up with his fearless colleagues in his mission to confront and defeat the evil forces of society
programme.desc: నిజాయితీగల, ధైర్యవంతుడైన పోలీసు అధికారి సింబా, తన సహచరులతో కలిసి సమాజంలోని దుష్ట శక్తులను ఎదుర్కొవాలనుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: ఛోటా భీమ్
programme.sub-title: Bheem is an extremely brave, strong and intelligent young boy. He often manages to solve everyone's problems which endears him to the townspeople of Dholakpur
programme.desc: చాలా ధైర్యవంతుడు, బలమైన, తెలివైన బాలుడు భీమ్, ఢోలక్‌పూర్‌ పట్టణవాసుల సమస్యలన్నింటినీ పరిష్కరించగలుగుతాడు.

credits.actor: Vatsal Dubey (Chhota Bheem),Julie Tejwani (Raju),Rupa Bhimani (Chutki),Sabina Malik Mausam (Kalia),Rajesh Kava (Jaggu),Prince Patel (Takiya)

programme.title: జై జగన్నాథ్
programme.sub-title: The host shines light on the annual chariot procession held in the honour of Lord Jagannath in Puri, Odisha, which is attended by numerous devotees from all over the country
programme.desc: ఒడిశాలోని పూరీలో జగన్నాథ స్వామి గౌరవార్థం జరిగే వార్షిక రథోత్సవంపై వివరిస్తారు, దేశం నలుమూలల నుండి భక్తులు హాజరవుతారు.

programme.sub-title: The ruined city of Pataliputra wears a haunted look. Vultures in the sky, withered trees, broken buildings and pained expressions on the faces of survivors. Krishna arrives in Dholakpur and goes straight to meet Bheem for help. Bheem and team
programme.desc: ఇంద్రవర్మ రాజును కిర్మాదా బంధించిన తరువాత ఛోటా భీమ్, అతని స్నేహితులు ప్రజలను కాపాడటానికి కాన్హతో చేతులు కలుపుతారు.

programme.title: ఛోటా భీమ్ ఔర్ కృష్ణ :పాట్లీపుత్ర
programme.sub-title: The people of Pataliputra are in danger when the evil demon Kirmada starts to hunt them in order to regain his physical form. Soon, Krishna and Bheem must find a way to stop him and save the city
programme.desc: దుష్ట రాక్షసుడు కిర్మదా నుండి పాటలీపుత్ర నగరాన్ని, ప్రజలను కాపాడడానికి కృష్ణ, భీమ్ ఒక మార్గాన్ని కనుగొనాలి.

credits.actor: Vatsal Dubey,Rupa Bhimani,Julie Tejwani,Rajesh Kava,Jigna Bhardwaj,Arun Shekar

programme.title: అల్టిమేట్ సోల్జర్: సైబోర్గ్స్ కా తెహెల్కా
programme.sub-title: Little Singham forms a team of heroes who fight against evil beings with the help of advanced technology in a bid to save the world against danger
programme.desc: లిటిల్ సింగం, తన హీరోల బృందం ప్రపంచాన్ని రక్షించే ప్రయత్నంలో దుష్టజీవులతో పోరాడటానికి అధునాతన సాంకేతికతను ఉపయోగిస్తుంది.

programme.title: అల్టిమేట్ సోల్జర్: దుష్మనో కా కెహెర్
programme.sub-title: Little Singham and friends battle Pirate Fox, an evil entity, in order to prevent them from creating a cyborg army and to protect the innocent
programme.desc: లిటిల్ సింగం, మిత్రులు సైబోర్గ్ సైన్యాన్ని సృష్టించకుండా,అమాయకులను కాపాడటానికి పైరేట్ ఫాక్స్ సంస్థతో పోరాడతారు.

programme.title: అల్టిమేట్ సోల్జర్: ఆఖిర్ ముఖాబ్లా
programme.sub-title: Little Singham along with his brave team faces relentless battles against sinister forces. Together, they outwit evil beings to stop their ultimate plan and protect the world from destruction
programme.desc: లిటిల్ సింగం, అతడి బృందంతో కలిసి దుష్టశక్తుల ప్రణాళికలను అడ్డుకుని, ప్రపంచాన్ని కాపాడడానికి పోరాడతాడు.

programme.title: గ్రిజ్జీ అండ్ ద లెమ్మింగ్స్
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house

programme.desc: చాలా ధైర్యవంతుడు, బలమైన, తెలివైన బాలుడు భీమ్, ఢోలక్‌పూర్‌ పట్టణవాసుల సమస్యలన్నింటినీ పరిష్కరించగలుగుతాడు.

credits.actor: Vatsal Dubey (Chhota Bheem),Julie Tejwani (Raju),Rupa Bhimani (Chutki),Sabina Malik Mausam (Kalia),Rajesh Kava (Jaggu),Prince Patel (Takiya)

programme.title: జై జగన్నాథ్
programme.sub-title: The host shines light on the annual chariot procession held in the honour of Lord Jagannath in Puri, Odisha, which is attended by numerous devotees from all over the country
programme.desc: ఒడిశాలోని పూరీలో జగన్నాథ స్వామి గౌరవార్థం జరిగే వార్షిక రథోత్సవంపై వివరిస్తారు, దేశం నలుమూలల నుండి భక్తులు హాజరవుతారు.

programme.title: గ్రిజ్జీ అండ్ ద లెమ్మింగ్స్
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: గ్రిజ్జీ అనే ఎలుగుబంటి ఒక అటవీ రేంజర్ ఇంటిని తన సొంత నివాసంగా భావిస్తుంది, అయితే లెమ్మింగ్స్ రాకతో పరిస్థితి మారుతుంది.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.title: సంపత్ చంపత్
programme.sub-title: Follow the hilarious misadventures of Sampat and Champat, two bumbling thieves who constantly hatch chaotic plans that backfire, landing them in endless trouble with the local police
programme.desc: సంపత్, చంపత్ అనే ఇద్దరు చేతకాని దొంగలు నిరంతరం స్థానిక పోలీసుల చిక్కుల్లో పడే హాస్యభరితమైన సాహసాలను అనుసరించండి.

programme.desc: This wildlife documentary follows Hugh Fearnley-Whittingstall and a team of experts as they travel across seas to find the world's most extraordinary animal stories. programme.title: Material Witness
programme.desc: The FBI suspects' fraudulent business practices are linked to the mysterious disappearance of Candor Diamond Corporation president, Irwin Margolies. Weeks after Margolies turns up, and begins cooperating with authorities, several Candor employees are now the victims of brutal murders. The deaths all point to the work of a hired hit man, with possible links to Margolies, but it will take the concentrated efforts of federal agents to untangle the web of clues to convict the killers.

credits.actor: Mark Joy (Donald Nash),Carl Burrows,Keith Michael Gregory,Michael McKennitt,Tim L. Smith

programme.title: Monsters and Mysteries
programme.desc: Whether the protagonist is a Batsquatch, Skunk Ape, Mothman or Chupacabra, tales of mysterious creatures and unexplainable phenomena have been passed down generations. \"Monsters and Mysteries in America\" takes a trip across the U.S. to reveal the most cryptic, frightening and brow-furrowing stories. Each hourlong episode focuses on a specific region and the lore of residents who claim to have encountered legendary monsters, ancient spirits or alien beings. With America's dense forests, desert grasslands, and hundreds of miles of uninhabitable wilderness, could it really house -- or hide -- so many mysterious creatures?

programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: टेलीविजन के सर्वश्रेष्ठ कार्यक्रमों की प्रस्तुति।.

programme.title: 12 ज्योतिर्लिंग दर्शन
programme.sub-title: Devotees come together to participate in a pilgrimage to visit the 12 Jyotirlingas, which are considered a divine manifestation of Lord Shiva
programme.desc: भक्तगण 12 ज्योतिर्लिंगों के दर्शन हेतु तीर्थयात्रा में भाग लेने के लिए एकत्रित होते हैं, जिन्हें भगवान शिव का दिव्य स्वरूप माना जाता है।.

programme.title: धर्म कथा
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the teachings of the Almighty and encourages followers to take the path of spirituality
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, ईश्वर की शिक्षाओं पर प्रकाश डालते हैं और अनुयायियों को आध्यात्मिकता का मार्ग अपनाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।.

programme.title: भक्ति प्रवाह
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of ancient hymns and spiritual verses chanted in order to praise the Almighty is played back to back
programme.desc: यह कार्यक्रम, परमेश्वर की स्तुति के लिए संगीतबद्ध किए गए प्राचीन भजनों और आध्यात्मिक छंदों का व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।.

programme.title: भूत बॉस (पाप-ओ-मीटर)
programme.sub-title: Bhoot Boss, Thakela and Pakela are ghosts who seek out people that have sinned and teach them a lesson to reduce wrongdoings in the world. However, their mission lands them in precarious situations
programme.desc: भूत बॉस, थकेला और पकेला भूत हैं जो पाप करने वाले लोगों को ढूंढ उन्हें सबक सिखाते हैं। हालांकि, उनका मिशन उन्हें अनिश्चित परिस्थितियों में डाल देता है।.

programme.title: जानबाज़ मुर्गा
programme.sub-title: A fun-loving chicken along with his friends embark on various adventures, as they overcome challenges and share heartfelt moments
programme.desc: एक मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला मुर्गा अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों पर निकलता है, जहां वे चुनौतियों पर विजय प्राप्त करते हैं और दिल को छू लेने वाले पल साझा करते हैं।.

programme.title: हनी बनी व़ाइटी
programme.sub-title: Honey and Bunny, two pet cats, engage in various adventures with other pets when Miss Katkar, their owner, goes out of the house
programme.desc: दो पालतू बिल्लियाँ हनी और बनी, जब उनकी मालकिन मिस काटकर घर से बाहर जाती हैं, तो वे अन्य पालतू जानवरों के साथ कई तरह के रोमांच में शामिल हो जाती हैं।.

programme.title: टेलीशॉपिंग
programme.sub-title: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता प्रसिद्ध ब्रांडों द्वारा निर्मित विभिन्न प्रकार के उत्पादों की विशेषताओं को प्रदर्शित करते हैं, जिन्हें घर बैठे आराम से खरीदा जा सकते हैं।.

programme.title: बबलू डबलू एए
programme.sub-title: To save their forest from the selfish motives of a logger, two bear brothers embark on various risky adventures to thwart his schemes
programme.desc: एक लकड़हारे के स्वार्थी इरादों से अपने जंगल को बचाने के लिए, दो भालू भाई उसकी योजनाओं को विफल करने के लिए विभिन्न जोखिम भरे साहसिक कार्य करते हैं।.

programme.title: टेलीशॉपिंग
programme.sub-title: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता प्रसिद्ध ब्रांडों द्वारा निर्मित विभिन्न प्रकार के उत्पादों की विशेषताओं को प्रदर्शित करते हैं, जिन्हें घर बैठे आराम से खरीदा जा सकते हैं।.

programme.title: यस बॉस
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: टेलीविजन के सर्वश्रेष्ठ कार्येक्रम।.

programme.title: मद्दाम सर
programme.sub-title: Four brave female police officers of Aminabad police station use their wittiness and emotional intelligence to tackle the various challenges they face at their work
programme.desc: अमीनाबाद पुलिस स्टेशन की चार बहादुर महिला पुलिस अधिकारी अपने कार्यस्थल की विभिन्न चुनौतियों से निपटने के लिए अपनी बुद्धिमता और भावनात्मक बुद्धिमत्ता का उपयोग करती हैं।.

credits.actor: Bhavika Sharma (Santosh \"Santu\" Sharma),Gulki Joshi (Haseena Mallik),Sonali Pandit Naik (Pushpa Singh),Yukti Kapoor (Karishma Singh),Rahil Azam (Anubhav Singh),Ajay Jadhav (Billu Champat),Yashkant Sharma (Cheteshwar \"Cheetah\" Chaturvedi),Priyanshu Singh (Cheteshwar \"Cheetah\" Chaturvedi)

programme.title: गुरु और भोले
programme.sub-title: Two close friends, Guru and Bhole, live in the quaint little town of Surtaal Nagar in North India. They always end up in sticky situations but have a musical adventure while trying to get out of it
programme.desc: दो जिगरी दोस्त गुरु और भोले, उत्तर भारत के एक अनोखे और पुराने छोटे शहर, सुर-ताल नगर में रहते हैं। वे अक्सर किसी न किसी मुसीबत में फँस जाते हैं लेकिन साहसिक कारनामे करते हुए उनसे बहार निकल आते हैं।.

programme.title: जंगल बुक
programme.sub-title: Mowgli, a young boy, is raised in the jungle by wolves. He has two loyal friends, Bagheera, a panther, and Baloo, a bear, who safeguard him from Shere Khan, a Bengal tiger, who wants to devour Mowgli
programme.desc: एक छोटा लड़का मोगली, जंगल में भेड़ियों के बीच पला-बढ़ा है। उसके दो वफादार दोस्त हैं, बघीरा (एक तेंदुआ), और बल्लू (एक भालू), जो उसे शेर खान (एक बंगाल टाइगर) से बचाते हैं, जो मोगली को खाना चाहता है।.

programme.title: बब्लू डबलू
programme.sub-title: An evil logger decides to turn the forest into his personal lumberyard. However, things change after Bablu and Dablu, two bear brothers, decide to stop him
programme.desc: एक दुष्ट लकड़हारा जंगल को अपना निजी लकड़हारा बनाने का फ़ैसला करता है। लेकिन, दो भालू भाइयों, बबलू और डबलू, द्वारा उसे रोकने के फ़ैसले के बाद चीज़ें बदल जाती हैं।.

programme.title: जीजा जी छत पर है
programme.sub-title: Elaichi's mischievous antics keep her father Murari on edge, while Pancham, secretly in love with her, navigates hilarious mishaps due to his hidden marital status
programme.desc: इलायची की शरारतें उसके पिता मुरारी को परेशान रखती हैं, जबकि पंचम, जो मन ही मन इलायची से प्यार करता है, अपनी छुपी हुई वैवाहिक स्थिति के कारण हास्यास्पद घटनाओं से गुजरता है।.

credits.actor: Hiba Nawab,Nikhil Khurana,Anup Upadhyay,Soma Rathod,Harveer Singh,Raashi Bawa,Firoz Khan,Naveen Bawa,Saheb Das Manikpuri

programme.title: मद्दाम सर
programme.sub-title: Four brave female police officers of Aminabad police station use their wittiness and emotional intelligence to tackle the various challenges they face at their work
programme.desc: अमीनाबाद पुलिस स्टेशन की चार बहादुर महिला पुलिस अधिकारी अपने कार्यस्थल की विभिन्न चुनौतियों से निपटने के लिए अपनी बुद्धिमता और भावनात्मक बुद्धिमत्ता का उपयोग करती हैं।.

programme.title: 12 ज्योतिर्लिंग दर्शन
programme.sub-title: Devotees come together to participate in a pilgrimage to visit the 12 Jyotirlingas, which are considered a divine manifestation of Lord Shiva
programme.desc: भक्तगण 12 ज्योतिर्लिंगों के दर्शन हेतु तीर्थयात्रा में भाग लेने के लिए एकत्रित होते हैं, जिन्हें भगवान शिव का दिव्य स्वरूप माना जाता है।.

programme.title: धर्म कथा
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the teachings of the Almighty and encourages followers to take the path of spirituality
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, ईश्वर की शिक्षाओं पर प्रकाश डालते हैं और अनुयायियों को आध्यात्मिकता का मार्ग अपनाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।.

programme.title: भक्ति प्रवाह
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of ancient hymns and spiritual verses chanted in order to praise the Almighty is played back to back
programme.desc: यह कार्यक्रम, परमेश्वर की स्तुति के लिए संगीतबद्ध किए गए प्राचीन भजनों और आध्यात्मिक छंदों का व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।.

programme.title: जानबाज़ मुर्गा
programme.sub-title: A fun-loving chicken along with his friends embark on various adventures, as they overcome challenges and share heartfelt moments
programme.desc: एक मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला मुर्गा अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों पर निकलता है, जहां वे चुनौतियों पर विजय प्राप्त करते हैं और दिल को छू लेने वाले पल साझा करते हैं।.

programme.title: हनी बनी व़ाइटी
programme.sub-title: Honey and Bunny, two pet cats, engage in various adventures with other pets when Miss Katkar, their owner, goes out of the house
programme.desc: दो पालतू बिल्लियाँ हनी और बनी, जब उनकी मालकिन मिस काटकर घर से बाहर जाती हैं, तो वे अन्य पालतू जानवरों के साथ कई तरह के रोमांच में शामिल हो जाती हैं।.

programme.sub-title: Two close friends, Guru and Bhole, live in the quaint little town of Surtaal Nagar in North India. They always end up in sticky situations but have a musical adventure while trying to get out of it
programme.desc: दो जिगरी दोस्त गुरु और भोले, उत्तर भारत के एक अनोखे और पुराने छोटे शहर, सुर-ताल नगर में रहते हैं। वे अक्सर किसी न किसी मुसीबत में फँस जाते हैं लेकिन साहसिक कारनामे करते हुए उनसे बहार निकल आते हैं।.

programme.title: बब्लू डबलू

programme.desc: एक दुष्ट लकड़हारा जंगल को अपना निजी लकड़हारा बनाने का फ़ैसला करता है। लेकिन, दो भालू भाइयों, बबलू और डबलू, द्वारा उसे रोकने के फ़ैसले के बाद चीज़ें बदल जाती हैं।.

programme.title: हनी बनी व़ाइटी
programme.sub-title: Honey and Bunny, two pet cats, engage in various adventures with other pets when Miss Katkar, their owner, goes out of the house
programme.desc: दो पालतू बिल्लियाँ हनी और बनी, जब उनकी मालकिन मिस काटकर घर से बाहर जाती हैं, तो वे अन्य पालतू जानवरों के साथ कई तरह के रोमांच में शामिल हो जाती हैं।.

programme.title: 12 ज्योतिर्लिंग दर्शन
programme.sub-title: Devotees come together to participate in a pilgrimage to visit the 12 Jyotirlingas, which are considered a divine manifestation of Lord Shiva
programme.desc: भक्तगण 12 ज्योतिर्लिंगों के दर्शन हेतु तीर्थयात्रा में भाग लेने के लिए एकत्रित होते हैं, जिन्हें भगवान शिव का दिव्य स्वरूप माना जाता है।.

programme.title: धर्म कथा
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the teachings of the Almighty and encourages followers to take the path of spirituality
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, ईश्वर की शिक्षाओं पर प्रकाश डालते हैं और अनुयायियों को आध्यात्मिकता का मार्ग अपनाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।.

programme.title: भक्ति प्रवाह
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of ancient hymns and spiritual verses chanted in order to praise the Almighty is played back to back
programme.desc: यह कार्यक्रम, परमेश्वर की स्तुति के लिए संगीतबद्ध किए गए प्राचीन भजनों और आध्यात्मिक छंदों का व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।.

programme.title: हनी बनी
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: टेलीविजन के सर्वश्रेष्ठ कार्यक्रमों की प्रस्तुति।.

programme.title: जांबाज मुर्गा
programme.sub-title: A trio of chickens resides on a lively farm. Meanwhile, two mischievous weasels from a chaotic junkyard plot to make a meal out of them
programme.desc: एक खेत में रहने वाली मुर्गियों की एक तिकड़ी को एक अव्यवस्थित कबाड़खाने में रहने वाले दो शरारती नेवले अपना भोजन बनाने की योजना बनाते हैं।.

programme.title: पीटर पैन
programme.sub-title: Peter Pan embarks on various adventures with his friends to fight the evil Captain Hook and his pirates and save Neverland
programme.desc: पीटर पैन एक दुष्ट कैप्टन हुक और उसके समुद्री डाकुओं से लड़ने और नेवरलैंड्स को बचाने के लिए अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों पर निकलता है।.

programme.title: जंगल बुक
programme.sub-title: Mowgli, a young boy, is raised in the jungle by wolves. He has two loyal friends, Bagheera, a panther, and Baloo, a bear, who safeguard him from Shere Khan, a Bengal tiger, who wants to devour Mowgli
programme.desc: एक छोटा लड़का मोगली, जंगल में भेड़ियों के बीच पला-बढ़ा है। उसके दो वफादार दोस्त हैं, बघीरा (एक तेंदुआ), और बल्लू (एक भालू), जो उसे शेर खान (एक बंगाल टाइगर) से बचाते हैं, जो मोगली को खाना चाहता है।.

programme.title: भूत बॉस (पाप-ओ-मीटर)
programme.sub-title: Bhoot Boss, Thakela and Pakela are ghosts who seek out people that have sinned and teach them a lesson to reduce wrongdoings in the world. However, their mission lands them in precarious situations
programme.desc: भूत बॉस, थकेला और पकेला भूत हैं जो पाप करने वाले लोगों को ढूंढ उन्हें सबक सिखाते हैं। हालांकि, उनका मिशन उन्हें अनिश्चित परिस्थितियों में डाल देता है।.

programme.desc: अमीनाबाद पुलिस स्टेशन की चार बहादुर महिला पुलिस अधिकारी अपने कार्यस्थल की विभिन्न चुनौतियों से निपटने के लिए अपनी बुद्धिमता और भावनात्मक बुद्धिमत्ता का उपयोग करती हैं।.

programme.desc: வருடத்தில் மிகவும் பிரபலமான மற்றும் பிரியமான சில இசை எண்களின் விரிவான தொகுப்பு, தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்பட்டது.

programme.title: Baal Krishna
programme.desc: Krishna, the young son of Devaki and Vasudeva, embarks on a series of adventures where he befriends the people of Vrindavan, his hometown, and saves them from difficulties.

credits.actor: Nimai Bali,Meet Mukhi,Sachin Shroff,Deshna Dugad,Ram Awana

programme.title: கணபதியே வருவாய்
programme.sub-title: After Lord Shiva beheads Ganesha, Goddess Parvati asks for his resurrection with an elephant's head. Despite facing many challenges after this, Ganesha transforms from an ostracized child into the most beloved deity
programme.desc: சிவன் கணேசனின் தலையை துண்டித்த பிறகு, பார்வதி தேவி யானை தலையுடன் மீண்டும் உயிர்ப்பிக்குமாறு கோரியபின், சவால்களை எதிர்கொண்டு, கணேசன் ஒதுக்கப்பட்ட குழந்தையிலிருந்து மிகவும் விரும்பப்படும் தெய்வமாகிறார்.

programme.title: கால பைரவன்
programme.sub-title: Jogeshwari is the daughter of Dakshan who hates Shiva and worships Vishnu. When Dakshan forces Jogeshwari to marry, she rebels because of her dedication towards Bhairavan, a devout devotee of Shiva
programme.desc: சிவனை வெறுத்து விஷ்ணுவை வழிபடும் தட்சன், அவரது மகள் ஜோகேஸ்வரியை திருமணம் செய்ய வற்புறுத்தும்போது, அவளோ சிவனின் தீவிர பக்தரான பைரவன் மீதான தனது பக்தியின் காரணமாக எதிர்க்கிறாள்.

programme.title: மூவி
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: திரைப்படங்களில் சிறந்தவை.

programme.title: அண்ணாமலை
programme.sub-title: Generations of rivalry come to light as two families fight for control of a revered temple while personal emotions complicate the path to peace
programme.desc: தனிப்பட்ட உணர்வுகள் அமைதிக்கான பாதையை சிக்கலாக்கும் அதே வேளையில், ஒரு புனிதமான கோவிலின் கட்டுப்பாட்டிற்காக இரண்டு குடும்பங்கள் சண்டையிடுவதால், தலைமுறையாக இருந்துவரும் அவர்களின் பகைமை வெளிச்சத்திற்கு வருகிறது.

credits.actor: Sivakumar,Radikaa Sarathkumar,Shyam Ganesh,Kuyili,Ponvannan,Viji Chandrasekhar,Shanmuga Sundaram,Jyothi Lakshmi

programme.title: தாமரை
programme.sub-title: Sneha and Dwarkesh fall in love, and they secretly register their marriage. However, their relationship is tested as they face various obstacles
programme.desc: காதலர்களான சினேகாவும் துவாரகேஷும் ரகசியமாக பதிவு திருமணம் செய்து கொள்கிறார்கள். ஆனால், அவர்கள் பல்வேறு தடைகளைச் சந்திக்கும் பொழுது அவர்களின் உறவு சோதிக்கப்படுகிறது.

credits.director: K.J Thangapandiyan,Hafees,A. Ramachandran,M.K. Arunthavaraja,S. Anand Babu

programme.title: Selvi
programme.desc: Selvi, a young girl, has academic ambition that she wants to pursue by moving to the city from her village. However, her family wants her to get married.

programme.title: அம்மன்
programme.sub-title: Sakthi is blessed by the Goddess Amman with the power to foresee the future. Her life takes an unexpected turn when she meets an atheist doctor
programme.desc: அம்மன் தேவியால் சக்தி எதிர்காலத்தை கணிக்கும் அருளை பெறுகிறாள். அவள் ஒரு நாத்திக மருத்துவரை சந்திக்கும்போது, அவளது வாழ்க்கை எதிர்பாராத திருப்பத்தை அடைகிறது.

credits.actor: Pavithra Gowda (Sakthi),Amaljith (Eshwar),Nivisha (Durga),Surjith Ansary (Kishore),Nanditha Jennifer (Saradha),Nisha Jagadeeswaran (Logambal),Shaliy Avinesh (Logambal),Shobana (Naga),Anita Nair (Lakshmi),Rathan Ganapathy (Mahendran),Avinash Ashok (Aravindh),Anu Sulash (Neha),Shubha Raksha (Inba)

programme.sub-title: After Lord Shiva beheads Ganesha, Goddess Parvati asks for his resurrection with an elephant's head. Despite facing many challenges after this, Ganesha transforms from an ostracized child into the most beloved deity
programme.desc: சிவன் கணேசனின் தலையை துண்டித்த பிறகு, பார்வதி தேவி யானை தலையுடன் மீண்டும் உயிர்ப்பிக்குமாறு கோரியபின், சவால்களை எதிர்கொண்டு, கணேசன் ஒதுக்கப்பட்ட குழந்தையிலிருந்து மிகவும் விரும்பப்படும் தெய்வமாகிறார்.

programme.title: கர்ணா
programme.sub-title: Karna, the son of the Sun God and Kunti, faces hardships from birth but strives to prove his worth. Overcoming challenges, he rises to become one of the most formidable archers and warriors in the Mahabharata
programme.desc: பிறப்பிலிருந்தே பல சவால்களை தாண்டி மகாபாரதத்தில் சிறந்த வில்லாளி மற்றும் போர்வீரராகும் சூரியன், குந்தியின் மகன் கர்ணன்.

programme.title: தெனாலி ராமன்
programme.sub-title: Tenali Raman, an advisor at the court of King Krishnadevaraya, uses his sharp presence of mind and wisdom to solve the difficult matters of the kingdom and its people daily
programme.desc: தனது கூர்மையான மனதையும் ஞானத்தையும் பயன்படுத்தி, ராஜ்ஜியம் மற்றும் மக்களின் கடினமான விஷயங்களை தீர்க்கும் தெனாலி ராமன்.

credits.actor: Krishna Bharadwaj,Pankaj Berry,Manav Gohil,Jitendra Pathak,Sohit Soni,Sanjay Mangnani,Priyamvada Kant,Nimisha Vakharia

programme.title: பாக்யஜாதகம்
programme.sub-title: Indulekha, a woman who gets a chance to reunite with Parvathy, her long-lost mother, after being abandoned by her own relatives at an early age
programme.desc: இந்துலேகா சிறு வயதிலேயே தன் சொந்த உறவினர்களால் கைவிடப்பட்ட பிறகு, நீண்ட நாட்களாகப் பிரிந்திருந்த தன் தாய் பார்வதியுடன் மீண்டும் இணையும் வாய்ப்பைப் பெறுகிறார்.

programme.title: அலாதின்

programme.title: கணபதியே வருவாய்
programme.sub-title: After Lord Shiva beheads Ganesha, Goddess Parvati asks for his resurrection with an elephant's head. Despite facing many challenges after this, Ganesha transforms from an ostracized child into the most beloved deity
programme.desc: சிவன் கணேசனின் தலையை துண்டித்த பிறகு, பார்வதி தேவி யானை தலையுடன் மீண்டும் உயிர்ப்பிக்குமாறு கோரியபின், சவால்களை எதிர்கொண்டு, கணேசன் ஒதுக்கப்பட்ட குழந்தையிலிருந்து மிகவும் விரும்பப்படும் தெய்வமாகிறார்.

programme.title: கால பைரவன்
programme.sub-title: Jogeshwari is the daughter of Dakshan who hates Shiva and worships Vishnu. When Dakshan forces Jogeshwari to marry, she rebels because of her dedication towards Bhairavan, a devout devotee of Shiva
programme.desc: சிவனை வெறுத்து விஷ்ணுவை வழிபடும் தட்சன், அவரது மகள் ஜோகேஸ்வரியை திருமணம் செய்ய வற்புறுத்தும்போது, அவளோ சிவனின் தீவிர பக்தரான பைரவன் மீதான தனது பக்தியின் காரணமாக எதிர்க்கிறாள்.

programme.title: மூவி
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television

programme.title: அண்ணாமலை

programme.title: वक्त की आवाज़
programme.sub-title: A rich girl runs away from home and settles down with a truck driver. However, her dream life is shattered when she learns that her new lover has been accused of murder
programme.desc: लता विवाह से बचने के लिए घर से भाग जाती है। वह ट्रक चालक, विश्वा से मिलती है और उसे उससे प्यार हो जाता है, लेकिन उसकी उम्मीदें टूट जाती है जब उसे पता चलता है कि वह एक हत्यारा है।.

credits.actor: Mithun Chakraborty (Vishwa Pratap),Sridevi (Lata),Moushumi Chatterjee (Justice Sharda),Vikas Anand (Jailor),Asrani (Chirag),Gulshan Grover (Rajan S Thakkar),Ranjeet (Shera),Kader Khan (Sikandar Lal Thakkar),Shreeram Lagoo (Ishwar Prasad)

programme.title: दुलारा
programme.sub-title: Falsely accused of murder, Raja becomes a target for Vijay, a police inspector and his lover's brother. In a bid to end his misery and catch the real culprit, Raja sets out on a mission
programme.desc: प्रिया का भाई इ. विजय जानता है कि उसके प्रेमी राजा के पिता ने दो महिलाओं की हत्या की है. क्या राजा भी इस ह्त्या का दोषी है?

programme.title: आइ प्राउड टू बी एन इंडियन
programme.sub-title: I, a man from India, travels to London for a family wedding and finds that their community is being threatened by a racist group. Seeing this, he decides to get involved and fight back
programme.desc: भारत का एक युवक, आइ परिवार में एक शादी के लिए लंदन जाता है और देखता है कि उनके समुदायों को श्वेत लोगों ने डराकर रखा हुआ है। यह देखकर, वह उनसे लड़ने का फैसला करता है।.

credits.actor: Sohail Khan (I),Kulbhushan Kharbanda (I's dad),Tim Lawrence (Cain),Scott Hinds (Bolt),Alex Mileman (Crumb),Zaf Mughal (Balbir Singh),James Owen (Monk),Heena Tasleem

programme.title: ड्रीम गर्ल
programme.sub-title: A young woman, conning people to run an orphanage, falls in love with a rich man under the disguise of a princess. However, their romance crumbles when her truth comes out
programme.desc: सपना, बच्चों के अनाथालय के पैसे जमा करने के लिए अमीर लोगों को ठगाती है। जब वह अनुपम से मिलती है, तो खुद को एक राजकुमारी बताती है और उन्हें प्यार हो जाता है लेकिन जल्द ही, सच्चाई सामने आ जाती है।.

credits.actor: Ashok Kumar,Dharmendra,Hema Malini,Prem Chopra,Lalita Pawar,Dina Pathak,Komilla Wirk,Alka

programme.title: अवतार
programme.sub-title: Avatar leads a happy life with his wife, Radha, and his sons, Chander and Ramesh. However, consumed by their greed and ambitions, Avatar's sons betray him, but he soon reaches new heights of success
programme.desc: अवतार के बेटे उसे और उसकी पत्नी को उनके हाल पर छोड़ देते हैं। हालाँकि, अपने बेटों द्वारा बेदखल किए जाने पर अवतार सफलता की नई ऊँचाईयों पर पहुँचता है।.

credits.actor: Rajesh Khanna,Shabana Azmi,Madan Puri,Sujit Kumar,A. K. Hangal,Sachin,Gulshan Grover

programme.title: गुप्त
programme.sub-title: After his stepfather is murdered, Sahil gets arrested, but he manages to escape prison to prove his innocence. However, Inspector Udham Singh sets off to capture him
programme.desc: साहिल पर अपने सौतेले पिता की हत्या का आरोप लगता है लेकिन वह अपनी बेगुनाही साबित करने का निश्चय करता है। साहिल, शीतल की मदद से जेल से फरार होता है, हालांकि एक बहादुर पुलिसकर्मी उसकी तलाश में है।.

credits.actor: Bobby Deol (Sahil Sinha),Manisha Koirala (Sheetal Choudhry),Om Puri (Insp. Udham Singh),Prem Chopra (Mantri),Raza Murad (Lawyer Thanawala),Dilip Tahil (Meghnath Choudhry),Kajol (Isha Diwan),Raj Babbar (Gov. Jaisingh Sinha)

programme.title: अमृत
programme.sub-title: A widowed man and woman face abuse from their respective children and seek comfort from each other instead
programme.desc: अपने बच्चों द्वारा प्रताड़ित एक बुज़ुर्ग विधवा, कमला, अमृत नाम के एक विधुर से मिलती है, जो खुद भी बच्चों द्वारा प्रताड़ित है।उनमें एक बंधन जुड़ने के बाद दोनों एक-दूसरे के दर्द को बाँटते हैं।.

credits.actor: Rajesh Khanna,Smita Patil,Aruna Irani,Anita Kanwar,Shafi Inamdar,Satish Shah,Rajesh Puri,Baby Guddu,Pradeep Saxena,Rishabh Shukla,Daljit Kaur,Master Ashutosh

programme.title: लव के लिए कुछ भी करेगा
programme.sub-title: Prakash plans to extort money from his distrusting father-in-law. Rahul and Harry, who are in desperate need of cash, join hands with Prakash and help kidnap his wife as part of the plan
programme.desc: प्रकाश, अपने अविश्वासी ससुर से पैसे निकालने की योजना बनाता है। उसके साथ राहुल और हैरी हाथ मिलाते हैं, जिन्हें पैसे की सख्त जरूरत है और योजना के तहत उसकी पत्नी का अपहरण करने में मदद करते हैं।.

credits.actor: Saif Ali Khan,Fardeen Khan,Sonali Bendre,Twinkle Khanna,Johnny Lever,Dalip Tahil,Sharat Saxena,Snehal Owasi,Suresh Bhagwat,Tanikella Bharani,Subha,Hyder Ali,Dilip Pavle,Satish Joshi,Mukesh Bhatt,Anil Upadhyay,Anupam Shyam,Aftab Shivdasani,Paresh Rawal

programme.title: बंपर ड्रॉ
programme.sub-title: Sunderlal and Farooq befriend each other in odd circumstances, but when they meet wealthy Pestonji, they hatch a cunning plan to use him to escape their money troubles
programme.desc: सुंदरलाल और फ़ारुक़ कई समस्याओं के बावज़ूद एक-दूसरे के मित्र बन जाते हैं। उनकी परेशानियाँ आगे और बढ़ जाती हैं जब वे एक वृद्ध पारसी आदमी, पेस्टोनजी से मिलते हैं।.

credits.actor: Seema Azmi,Narendra Bedi,Bomie E. Dotiwala,Subrat Dutta,Rajpal Yadav,Zakir Hussain,Omkar Das Manikpuri,Rushad Rana

programme.title: Fun2shh... Dudes in the 10th Century
programme.desc: Three men are accused of stealing a crown and whilst on the run, they are transported to the 10th century. Amidst several adventures, they must try to bring the crown back to prove their innocence.

credits.actor: Paresh Rawal,Iqbal Khan,Anuj Sawhney,Gulshan Grover,Raima Sen,Farida Jalal,Kader Khan,Amitabh Bachchan

programme.title: नयी पड़ोसन
programme.sub-title: Three men try different methods to woo their neighbour. However, her father wants her to get married to someone from his community
programme.desc: तीन पुरुष अपनी पड़ोसन को लुभाने और उससे शादी करने के लिए अलग-अलग प्रयास करते हैं।लेकिन उसके पिता उसकी शादी अपने समुदाय के किसी व्यक्ति से कराना चाहते है।.

programme.title: बलविंदर सिंह... फेमस हो गया
programme.sub-title: Two struggling actors from Punjab who have the same name, Balwinder Singh, come to Mumbai and fall in love with the same woman
programme.desc: पंजाब के दो संघर्षशील अभिनेता, जिनका नाम एक ही है, बलविंदर सिंह, मुंबई आते हैं और एक ही महिला से प्यार करने लगते हैं।.

credits.actor: Mika Singh,Gabriela Bertante,Anupam Kher,Vindu Dara Singh,Rajpal Yadav,Govardhan Asrani,Mikhill Chandiramani,Rajshekhar Kapoor

programme.sub-title: Pehlwaan, a criminal, narrowly escapes a police encounter and uses a holy man's guise to hide. Though he soon amasses many followers, he continues to carry out his illegal activities
programme.desc: पुलिस से जान बचाकर भागने के बाद पहलवान नाम का एक अपराधी एक बाबा होने का ढोंग करता है। जल्द ही वह इसकी आड़ में वह कई भक्त जुटाता है और अवैध गतिविधियाँ भी चलाता है।.

credits.actor: Abhimanyu Singh,Pankaj Tripathi,Ravi Kishan,Sandeepa Dhar,Akhilendra Mishra,Sanjay Mishra,Vishwa Bhanu,Seema Azmi

programme.title: संगदिल सनम
programme.sub-title: Falsely accused of robbery and sent to prison for 12 years, a bank manager realises upon his return that a person whom he trusted had betrayed him
programme.desc: एक बैंक प्रबंधक, कैलाश नाथ को अपने बेटे के ससुर, शंकर द्वारा डकैती के लिए फँसा कर जेल भेज दिया जाता है। वर्षों बाद, वह रिहा होता है और शंकर का आमना - सामना करने का फैसला करता है।.

credits.actor: Salman Khan,Manisha Koirala,Alok Nath,Reema Lagoo,Kiran Kumar,Raza Murad,Ashok Saraf,Shiva Rindani

programme.title: घराना
programme.sub-title: Prem Mehra loses everything after one of his employees joins hands with his rapacious rival and the two plot against him. Later, his sons work together to retrieve their family's lost wealth
programme.desc: प्रेम मेहरा अपनी सारी संपत्ति खो देता है जब उसका प्रतिद्वंद्वी धर्मदास, प्रेम के कर्मचारी के साथ मिलकर उसके हीरे चुराता है। अब परिवार को हुए इस नुकसान की भरपाई प्रेम के बेटों को ही करनी होगी।.

credits.actor: Rishi Kapoor,Govinda,Meenakshi Sheshadri,Jaya Prada,Neelam,Tanuja,Asrani,Bharat Bhushan,Prem Chopra,Ramesh Deo

programme.title: बेटा
programme.desc: After the death of his mother, Raju's father re-marries, but his stepmother is only after the family's money. When Raju eventually marries, his wife tries to make him realise what kind of woman his stepmother is.

credits.actor: Anil Kapoor (Raju),Madhuri Dixit (Saraswati),Anupam Kher (Totaram),Akash Khurana (Prem),Aruna Irani (Laxmi Devi),Laxmikant Berde (Pandu Dhondu Bhikaji Rao),Adi Irani (Ramesh),Rita Bhaduri (Neeta)

programme.title: एडवेंचर्स ऑफ़ टार्ज़न
programme.sub-title: Ruby ventures into the forest searching for a legendary tribe but encounters Tarzan and falls for him. However, her father and fiancé plot to capture him and sell him to the circus
programme.desc: रुबी एक काल्पनिक जनजाति की तलाश में जंगल में जाती है, जहाँ वह संयोगवश टार्ज़न से मिलती है और उसे उससे प्यार होता है। हालाँकि, रुबी के पिता और उसका मंगेतर उनके खिलाफ साजिश रचते हैं।.

credits.actor: Hemant Birje,Kimi Katkar,Narendra Nath,Om Shivpuri,Dalip Tahil,Sudhir

programme.title: प्यार ही प्यार
programme.sub-title: At an orphanage, Kailashnath identifies Vijay as his biological son and takes him home. Years later, a man named Ashok arrives and claims to be Kailashnath's real son
programme.desc: कैलाशनाथ एक अनाथालय में अपने बेटे विजय को पहचानता है और उसे घर ले आता है। वर्षों बाद, अशोक नाम का एक व्यक्ति, कैलाशनाथ का असली बेटा होने का दावा करता है।.

programme.title: रजनीगंधा
programme.sub-title: Deepa, a young woman, meets Sanjay and falls in love with him. But when she goes to Bombay to look for a job, the arrival of a former lover puts her in a quandary
programme.desc: दीपा अपने कॉलेज के दोस्त, संजय से प्यार करती है और उससे शादी करने वाली है। हालाँकि, वह संयोगवश अपने पूर्व-प्रेमी, नवीन से मिलती है और उसके बाद दोनों में से किसी एक को चुनने की दुविधा में फंस जाती है।.

credits.actor: Vidya Sinha,Amol Palekar,Dinesh Thakur,Ranjita Thakur,Veena Godh,Manju Maini,Master Chicoo,Raj Prakash

programme.title: बम बम बोले
programme.sub-title: An idealist elder brother lands in a dilemma after he misplaces his little sister's shoes. Unable to afford a new pair, the siblings agree to share the shoes, leading to several escapades
programme.desc: भाई बहन, जूते की एक जोड़ी साझा करने का फैसला करते हैं जब तक कि उनके पिता नया जूता नहीं खरीदते हैं। लेकिन हालात बदलते हैं जब नौकरी खोजने में असमर्थ उनके पिता पर अपराधी होने का संदेह किया जाता है।.

programme.desc: The Secret World of Snakes.

programme.title: ప్రైడ్ రూల్స్
programme.sub-title: Come full circle as the dry season descends and the Waterfront Pride enjoys good hunting and renewed confidence in their territory. Then celebrate the success of former outsider Einstein, who gets down to business as the king of his very own pride
programme.desc: Explores the life of lions, their survival instincts and their habit of protecting their pride.

programme.title: Wild Spain - A tale of two brothers
programme.desc: The connection of two brothers and wildlife filmmakers with Spanish nature, through spectacular images of the social life of dolphins, whales, or jellyfish in the Mediterranean Sea. Sergi and Jordi Escandell manage to tell a different story.

programme.title: వైల్డ్ బ్యాటిల్ గ్రౌండ్
programme.sub-title: There is an icy heat of aggression in some of the coldest habitats on Earth, as life-threatening environmental conditions bring out predators' competitive sides
programme.desc: Different animals use the terrain and their unique attributes to their advantage and defeat their opponents at each location, becoming masters of communication, camouflage, diplomacy, and combat.

programme.title: సన్స్ ఆఫ్ ఎంకై
programme.sub-title: An intimate look at the relationship between man and nature in one of the most iconic wild places on Earth: the Masai Mara, Kenya. A Maasai warrior guides viewers through natural epic events and spectacular wildlife
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు గ్రహం మీద అత్యంత ప్రసిద్ధి చెందిన అరణ్య ప్రాంతాలలో ప్రకృతి, మానవజాతి మధ్య బంధాన్ని నిశితంగా పరిశీలిస్తారు.

programme.title: వైల్డ్ ఫైటర్స్
programme.sub-title: The love rivalry shakes every fibre of the body as hormones invade the blood, and some of the most overwhelming spectacles on the planet are produced; the language of love and the fight for reproduction stimulate the most diverse behaviours
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు ప్రపంచంలోని వివిధ ప్రాంతాలలో మనుగడ కోసం అడవి జంతువులు అనుసరించే వ్యూహాలు, పద్దతుల గురించి చూపుతారు.

programme.title: టెక్సాస్ గేటర్ సేవర్స్
programme.sub-title: A new intern is tasked with helping the team remove a gator from a 20-foot deep well, and Callie and Shannon rescue a gator hanging out near a movie theatre
programme.desc: గ్యారీ సౌరేజ్, అతని బృందం వివిధ అసాధారణ ప్రదేశాలలోని మొసళ్ళను రక్షించి, కొత్త వాతావరణంలో వాటి సంక్షేమానికి తోడ్పడతారు.

programme.desc: With a constantly churning molten core, the planet rearranges continents like pieces of a giant puzzle; each episode focuses on one dramatic geological change and its effects on the wildlife - covering the Americas, Africa, Australia and Eurasia.

programme.title: వైల్డ్ ఫైటర్స్
programme.sub-title: Investigating the different reasons that lead animals to face tough disputes

programme.title: Fight for Territory
programme.desc: Biological instinct is driven by three things: the desire to stay alive, to find food and to breed. But to do all these things, animals first need a home. Out in the wilderness a safe place to call home can be the difference between life and death. A place to secure meals, raise their families and hide from danger. Ideal spots are in short supply and well worth fighting for!

programme.title: మై జాగ్వార్ లైఫ్
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: అత్యుత్తమ టెలివిజన్ కార్యక్రమాలు.

programme.title: లయనెస్ ఇన్ ఎక్సైల్
programme.sub-title: Manyari takes an unusual step when she takes her young cubs away from the sanctuary of the clan
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు, తన పిల్లలను రక్షిస్తూ, సవాళ్లను అధిగమించడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తున్న ఆడ సింహం ప్రయాణాన్ని అనుసరిస్తారు.

programme.title: ఎ రైనోస్ లైఫ్
programme.sub-title: A mother rhinoceros trains her two-year-old son to survive in the grasslands of Uganda, and both undergo a test of time when she gives birth to a new calf
programme.desc: ఉగాండాలో తన రెండేళ్ల కొడుకుకి మనుగడ నైపుణ్యాలు నేర్పుతున్న ఖడ్గమృగం మరొకరికి జన్మనిచ్చినప్పుడు సవాళ్లు ఎదుర్కొంటాయి.

programme.title: ది ఇన్‌క్రెడిబుల్ ఫైవ్: ఎ చీతాస్ టేల్
programme.sub-title: Cheetahs are the high-speed hunters of the Savannah but few attempt to take on larger prey than gazelles or smallish antelopes
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు సవన్నాలో హై-స్పీడ్ హంటర్స్ అని పిలవబడే చిరుతలకు సంబంధించిన ఆశ్చర్యకరంగా భిన్నమైన కోణాన్ని అన్వేషిస్తారు.

programme.desc: The Savannah: Wild Happiness.

programme.desc: United Animals.

programme.title: డై లియోపార్డిన్
programme.sub-title: The Serengeti and its labyrinth of gallery forests are the home of a leopardess. To her family she is both caring provider and fearless defender. For her prey she is sudden death, for her son the only chance to survive in this unforgiving wilderness
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు చిరుతపులిలను వాటి సహజ నివాస స్థలంలో బంధించాడు,పిల్లిజాతి ప్రెడేటర్ సామాజిక జీవితం, మనుగడ వ్యూహాలపై వివరిస్తారు.

programme.title: ది గ్రేట్ రైనో రాబరీ
programme.sub-title: Not long after a mysterious robbery took a stuffed rhino head from an auction house in 2011, baffled police realised they faced a bizarre crime wave when almost 100 rhino horns were stolen over a year
programme.desc: In 2011, thieves started stealing rhino horns from museums and auction houses in a bizarrely British crime wave that swept the country, and the police were at a loss as to who was responsible.

credits.actor: Steven R. Galster,Paolo Viscardi,Paulo Mota,William Fowlds

programme.title: వైల్డ్ బై నేచర్
programme.sub-title: WILD BY NATURE is a television series about wild nature, which deals with the endemic fauna of Mexico, narrated from a fresh, intrepid, and original point of view with a message of conservation and care for our species. Our protagonist, the actor and naturalist Arturo Islas travels through the going into their jungles, deserts, and seas in search of the wonderful species of fauna: mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians, fish, and insects. WILD BY NATURE is a great experience of adventure and knowledge of natural wealth
programme.desc: నటుడు, ప్రకృతి శాస్త్రవేత్త ఆర్థర్ ఇస్లాస్ అనేక రకాల జంతువుల ఆవాసాలు, వాటికి సంబంధించిన ఆసక్తికర విషయాలను పంచుకుంటారు.

programme.title: సర్వైవ్ ద వైల్డ్
programme.sub-title: To provide an edge to survive in their habitats, some animals have developed techniques that allow them to share information. For those that harness the power of communication, the advantage is theirs
programme.desc: Investigating the tactics and strategies used by animals in the wild.

programme.title: ద జూ
programme.sub-title: Located just 10 miles from New York's Times Square, the Bronx Zoo is a recognised world leader in animal care and species conservation. It houses more than 6,000 animals and has a staff of 500-plus people dedicated to their care and well-being. Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు అంతరించిపోతున్న జాతులను రక్షించడంలో, వన్యప్రాణులను సంరక్షించడానికి బ్రాంక్స్ జూ చేస్తున్న ప్రయత్నాలను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: క్రికీ! ఇట్స్ ద ఇర్విన్స్
programme.sub-title: Carrying on late wildlife conservationist Steve Irwin's mission to bring people closer to animals is now the mission of his family. Terri, Bindi and Robert Irwin return to Animal Planet, giving viewers access to their wildlife adventures around the world and the amazing animals that continue to inspire their conservation efforts. The series features the family caring for more than 1,200 animals at the Australia Zoo; overseeing a world-class wildlife hospital, the largest of its kind in the world; and conducting high-level global expeditions
programme.desc: ఆస్ట్రేలియా జంతుశాలలో పనిచేస్తున్న ఇర్విన్ కుటుంబ సభ్యులు జంతువులను జాగ్రత్తగా చూసుకోవడానికి అనేక ఇబ్బందులు పడతారు.

programme.title: ఎర్త్స్ ట్రాపికల్ ఐలాండ్స్
programme.sub-title: From the makers of Earth's Greatest Rivers, Earth's Tropical Islands journeys to three of the most exotic, mysterious and remote islands on planet Earth: Madagascar, Borneo and Hawaii. In three episodes, the series reveals how these isolated and iconic tropical islands harbour remarkable wildlife and human castaways found nowhere else on Earth. Madagascar is the oldest island in the world, Borneo cradles more diversity of life than any other island, and Hawaii is the remotest island chain in the world. In a rapidly changing world, these fragile islands are a vital gauge for the health of our planet
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు మడగాస్కర్, బోర్నియో, హవాయిలోని అన్యదేశ, మారుమూల ద్వీపాలలో మానవ జనాభా, వన్యప్రాణుల చరిత్రను అన్వేషిస్తారు.

programme.title: ప్రైడ్ రూల్స్
programme.sub-title: Wildlife experts offer detailed insights into a pride of lions within the Serengeti National Park, in northern Tanzania, surviving the rigours of the land
programme.desc: The filmmaker explores the life of lions, their survival instincts and their habit of protecting their pride from other animals.

programme.title: Wild Spain - A tale of two brothers
programme.desc: The connection of two brothers and wildlife filmmakers with Spanish nature, through spectacular images of the social life of dolphins, whales, or jellyfish in the Mediterranean Sea. Sergi and Jordi Escandell manage to tell a different story.

programme.title: వైల్డ్ బ్యాటిల్ గ్రౌండ్
programme.desc: The filmmaker provides insights into some of the unique characteristics of various predatory animals while focusing on their survival instincts.

programme.sub-title: An intimate look at the relationship between man and nature in one of the most iconic wild places on Earth: the Masai Mara, Kenya

programme.sub-title: The team investigates the creative process behind the scenes of the hit programme. Meanwhile, the creators share insights into the challenges faced during the production of the latest series
programme.desc: గ్యారీ సౌరేజ్, అతని బృందం వివిధ అసాధారణ ప్రదేశాలలోని మొసళ్ళను రక్షించి, కొత్త వాతావరణంలో వాటి సంక్షేమానికి తోడ్పడతారు.

programme.desc: దర్శకుడు గ్రహం మీద అత్యంత ప్రసిద్ధి చెందిన అరణ్య ప్రాంతాలలో ప్రకృతి, మానవజాతి మధ్య బంధాన్ని నిశితంగా పరిశీలిస్తారు.

programme.title: Fight for Territory
programme.desc: Biological instinct is driven by three things: the desire to stay alive, to find food and to breed. But to do all these things, animals first need a home. Out in the wilderness a safe place to call home can be the difference between life and death. A place to secure meals, raise their families and hide from danger. Ideal spots are in short supply and well worth fighting for!

programme.title: మై జాగ్వార్ లైఫ్
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: అత్యుత్తమ టెలివిజన్ కార్యక్రమాలు.

programme.title: లయనెస్ ఇన్ ఎక్సైల్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker traces the journey of a lioness, striving to overcome the challenges of the wildlife ecosystem, along with protecting her cubs from danger
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు, తన పిల్లలను రక్షిస్తూ, సవాళ్లను అధిగమించడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తున్న ఆడ సింహం ప్రయాణాన్ని అనుసరిస్తారు.

programme.title: ఎ రైనోస్ లైఫ్
programme.sub-title: A mother rhinoceros trains her two-year-old son to survive in the grasslands of Uganda, and both undergo a test of time when she gives birth to a new calf
programme.desc: ఉగాండాలో తన రెండేళ్ల కొడుకుకి మనుగడ నైపుణ్యాలు నేర్పుతున్న ఖడ్గమృగం మరొకరికి జన్మనిచ్చినప్పుడు సవాళ్లు ఎదుర్కొంటాయి.

programme.title: ది ఇన్‌క్రెడిబుల్ ఫైవ్: ఎ చీతాస్ టేల్
programme.sub-title: The filmmakers shed light upon a surprisingly different side of cheetahs, known as the high-speed hunters of the Savannah and explores the life of male cheetahs living in small groups
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు సవన్నాలో హై-స్పీడ్ హంటర్స్ అని పిలవబడే చిరుతలకు సంబంధించిన ఆశ్చర్యకరంగా భిన్నమైన కోణాన్ని అన్వేషిస్తారు.

programme.title: ది సావన్నా: వైల్డ్ హ్యాపీనెస్
programme.desc: The Savannah: Wild Happiness.
